label: D2 after an a2 choice, early in the episode (first ~20 trials), when not just switched and value is high
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass) and only when this trial s GO choice was a2 (in_action == 2, 100% of mass); 96% of mass when the reached state is S2 (common). Strictly confined to early episode: 99% of mass in ep_trials < 20, none after trial 29. Almost never fires right after a switch (prev_action == 1 holds 4 of 11363 activations). Most mass (87%) at steps where the value head is in its top bin (> 8.1) and the policy strongly favors a2; 94% of mass in episodes that started with S2 good, i.e. the agent has been committed to a2 from the episode start. Base predicate (D2 & a2 & ep_trial<20 & stayed) gives dev F1 0.52, mass recall 0.99; adding value > 8.0 raises F1 to 0.63 (mass recall 0.95). Remaining false positives are similar early a2-stay D2 steps where it stays silent; run length of a2 choices within the window did not help. Activation magnitudes are tiny in absolute terms (max ~0.001). Does not fire at D1 or GO, after a1 choices, or late in the episode. All variables are observed at D2 (action is the agent s own choice, value is its own output).
